name: eldor
description: Eldor: make pacts with spirits and mend a shattered world. A spirit-collecting battle RPG for the browser.

scripts.cloud:db:local: wrangler d1 execute eldor -c worker/wrangler.jsonc --local --file worker/schema.sql
scripts.cloud:db: wrangler d1 execute eldor -c worker/wrangler.jsonc --remote --file worker/schema.sql
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler deploy -c worker/wrangler.static.jsonc
scripts.cloud:deploy: VITE_CLOUD=1 npm run build && wrangler deploy -c worker/wrangler.jsonc
